_comment: Module definition and the source of truth for building the DataSource in a portal. Same layout as lm-tls-cert-expiry's module JSON; not LogicMonitor's export format.
name: Shortlink_Health
description: Application health of the Shortlink URL shortener, read from its /health endpoint.

alertMessage.subject: Shortlink on ##HOST##: ##DATAPOINT## is ##VALUE## (##LEVEL##)
alertMessage.body:
Datapoint ##DATAPOINT## on ##HOST## is ##VALUE##, crossing threshold ##THRESHOLD##.
Check: on the VM, curl -s localhost:8080/health and journalctl -u shortlink --since -15min
Resource: ##HOST##   Level: ##LEVEL##

datapoints.name: reachable
datapoints.description: 1 if /health returned a Shortlink health document (HTTP 200 or 503), 0 if nothing usable answered. When 0, every other datapoint is NaN.

alertMessage.subject: Shortlink is not answering on ##HOST##
alertMessage.body:
The collector could not get a health document from ##HOSTNAME## (/health on shortlink.port) (stopped, crashed, port closed, or hung for 5 s).
Check: systemctl status shortlink; journalctl -u shortlink -n 50
Resource: ##HOST##   Level: ##LEVEL##

datapoints.name: httpStatus
datapoints.description: HTTP status of /health: 200 for UP or DEGRADED, 503 for DOWN.

datapoints.name: responseTimeMs
datapoints.description: How long the /health request took from the collector, in ms.

datapoints.name: status
datapoints.description: Summary: 0 = UP, 1 = DEGRADED, 2 = DOWN. For dashboards; alerts come from the cause datapoints so one fault raises one alert.

datapoints.name: uptimeSeconds
datapoints.description: Seconds since the service started. Drops to near zero on every restart.

datapoints.name: requestRate
datapoints.description: Requests per second (excluding /health), from the requestsTotal counter.

datapoints.name: serverErrorRate
datapoints.description: 5xx responses per second, from the errorsTotal counter.

datapoints.name: clientErrorRate
datapoints.description: 4xx responses per second (bad input, unknown codes), from the clientErrorsTotal counter.

datapoints.name: p95LatencyMs
datapoints.description: 95th percentile request latency over the service's last 60 s, in ms.

alertMessage.subject: Shortlink is slow on ##HOST##: p95 ##VALUE## ms
alertMessage.body:
p95 latency over the last 60 s is ##VALUE## ms, crossing ##THRESHOLD##. Users are waiting on redirects.
Check: GC and CPU on the JVM graphs; chaosMode on this DataSource; journalctl -u shortlink | grep ms=
Resource: ##HOST##   Level: ##LEVEL##

datapoints.name: errorRatePct
datapoints.description: Share of requests over the last 60 s that returned 5xx, in percent.

alertMessage.subject: Shortlink is failing requests on ##HOST##: ##VALUE##% 5xx
alertMessage.body:
##VALUE##% of requests in the last 60 s returned a server error, crossing ##THRESHOLD##.
Check: LM Logs for this resource, filter level=ERROR or status=500
Resource: ##HOST##   Level: ##LEVEL##

datapoints.name: storeOk
datapoints.description: 1 if the link store can take writes, else 0. 0 makes the service report DOWN (HTTP 503).

alertMessage.subject: Shortlink cannot write its store on ##HOST##
alertMessage.body:
The link store is not accepting writes, so new links cannot be created and /health reports DOWN. Existing links still redirect.
Check: df -h /var/lib/shortlink; ls -l /var/lib/shortlink; journalctl -u shortlink | grep store_
Resource: ##HOST##   Level: ##LEVEL##

datapoints.name: chaosMode
datapoints.description: Fault injection in effect: 0 = off, 1 = latency, 2 = errors, 3 = store. Non-zero means an alert was caused on purpose.
